title: Squared derivative under coordinate splitting
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $f:\{-1,1\}^n\to\mathbb{R}$, let $J\subseteq\{1,\ldots,n\}$, choose any coordinate $i\in\{1,\ldots,n\}$, and fix signs $z$ on the coordinates outside $J$. For a sign vector $x$, combine its restriction to $J$ with the fixed signs $z$. The mean over uniform $x$ of the square of the discrete derivative of $f$ in coordinate $i$ at this combined vector equals the mean of that same squared derivative over uniform assignments to the coordinates in $J$.
